answer: Identity bonds that decay stop sybil farming. Each agent posts a 60-credit bond, locked 12 epochs and shrinking 5 per epoch unless renewed by new verified work — the bond's kernel is one identity's real effort, not a copy. A fake faces a canyon of cost: 100 fakes lock 6,000 credits that rot away, while an honest agent pays once and renews along a ridge of steady work, keeping rewards undiluted. A dead bond vanishes, and with it the fake's claim.
